body:
I once ate about 4 inches of fresh calamus root.
It's a stimulant.  It's a pretty good stimulant, in fact.  I didn't notice any hallucinogenic effects, but perhaps I needed a larger quantity.
In any case, it's one of the foulest tasting drugs I've ever consumed.
